description: This file implements backend APIs for the MsgBusTestServer component of the COSA Data Model Library, including functions to set and get string and integer parameters, with some internal state variables.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the internal string parameter 'ParamString' if the parameter name matches.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of 'ParamString' if the parameter name matches.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the internal integer parameter 'ParamInt' if the parameter name matches.

methods.name: MsgBusTest_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of 'ParamInt' if the parameter name matches.
